1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 2 m de longitud, de cuerpo alargado, provisto de poderosos dientes y cola potente; su carne es comestible, pero al llegar a cierta edad se vuelve venenosa, produciendo la enfermedad llamada ciguatera. Spyraenidae Sphyraena barracuda, S. argenta, S. ensis, S. picudilla.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 2 meters in length, characterized by a slender body and powerful teeth, as well as a potent tail; its flesh is edible but becomes toxic at a certain age, causing the disease known as ciguatera. Spyraenidae Sphyraena barracuda, S. argenta, S. ensis, S. picudilla.
